response.overview: Eu sou como eu sou is a short documentary that reflects on existence, creation, and identity through the voices of five visual artists. Inspired by the dialogue between Torquato Neto’s poem *Cogito* and the idea of *Cogito ergo sum*, the film begins with a central question: in what ways does art permeate our lives and take part in shaping who we are? Through interviews, the artists share their relationships with art, their creative processes, and their singular ways of existing in the world. By embracing a diversity of voices and perspectives, the documentary creates a mosaic of identities in which creating and existing become intertwined.
response.title: Eu sou como eu sou
